a.text: Uses Pocket Lab Lite through the

a.xlink:title: Browser. Hosts the installed or web PWA and enforces browser-origin boundaries.
a.text: Hosts the installed or web PWA and

a.xlink:title: React / Vite PWA. Renders Lite screens and sends same-origin requests only to FastAPI through Caddy.

Frontend state ownership. Combines service worker, TanStack Query, Dexie safe snapshots, Zustand UI-only state, XState guided flows, API client, error boundaries, and generated fixtures without owning backend truth.
Caddy same-origin proxy. Serves the PWA and routes /api/lite/* and managed app paths without exposing backend secrets.
a.text: and managed app paths without exposing...

a.xlink:title: FastAPI /api/lite/*. Validates requests, owns safe read APIs, admits commands, and never delegates browser execution directly to NATS or shell.
Fleet, Apps, Security, Recovery, and Release APIs. Exposes domain-specific read and command endpoints while preserving backend-owned lifecycle execution.
Prepared read, health, readiness, diagnostics, and evidence APIs. Serves side-effect-free prepared projections, health/readiness, compact diagnostics, and sanitized evidence lookups.
Identity, authentication, and invite guards. Applies human authentication/session/CSRF guards plus device identity, duplicate, protected-host, and fail-closed invite/bootstrap acceptance guards.

Passkey, step-up, and Enterprise identity controls. Verifies passkeys, records purpose-bound session assurance, and resolves server-owned Enterprise memberships and final-Owner protection; it does not create a browser-held authority.
OPA Safety Rules policy engine. Evaluates only registered protected actions after FastAPI hard invariants and before existing NATS/worker execution; it never owns command execution.
App Catalog. Presents backend-owned app lifecycle and safe action readiness, including same-origin Open routes and Manage details.
Security scan coordinator. Validates Quick, Full, and App Check requests, tracks active runs, and exposes compact split-read summaries.
a.text: Validates Quick, Full, and App Check

a.xlink:title: NATS / JetStream. Provides the command and event backbone with durable delivery; it is never contacted directly by the frontend.
a.text: backbone with durable delivery; it is...

a.xlink:title: Worker process. Consumes durable commands and owns backend execution for apps, security, recovery, releases, and lifecycle work.
Command admission and lifecycle. Tracks admission, queued, claimed, running, terminal, acknowledgement, retry, and dead-letter behavior independently from device lifecycle.
Backup and verification engine. Creates and verifies local encrypted backups through backend/worker-owned operations.
Release subprocess. Owns network, download, verification, staging, apply, and rollback work outside the FastAPI event loop.
Completion and audit evidence. Records sanitized lifecycle and completion evidence for commands, devices, apps, security, recovery, and releases.
Device command executor. Executes approved device commands in the node agent and publishes truthful results.
a.text: the node agent and publishes truthful...

a.xlink:title: SQLite control-plane store. Stores canonical Lite lifecycle state and prepared projections; the frontend never accesses it directly.

Audit index, projection refresh, prepared projections, and domain revisions. Indexes audit evidence and tracks dirty signals, generations, committed projections, current-state summaries, and semantic revisions.
Invite and identity lifecycle. Tracks pending, accepted, revoked, blocked, and consumed invite/identity state with duplicate and mismatch guards.
Enrollment and device lifecycle state. Retains enrolled devices across connectivity loss and separates durable enrollment, current state, health, supervisor state, and recovery history.
Backup, restore, and checkpoint state. Stores backup manifests, recovery operations, current state, database backups/restores, and restore checkpoints.
Security findings and run state. Stores scan runs, tools, progress, findings, profile snapshots, and sanitized evidence references.
Installed release and runtime state. Stores installed-release identity and release-runtime projection for truthful comparison, staging, apply, rollback, and last-known-good state.
App, command, and workflow state. Stores canonical app current/action lifecycle and workflow command/current/event state.
PM2 process manager. Starts and supervises approved server-host and joined-device processes with bounded restart policies.
Lite node agent. Connects to NATS, publishes heartbeat/telemetry/health, handles device commands, and reconnects after outages.
a.text: Server host or joined device · PM2

a.xlink:title: Lite agent supervisor. Runs separately from the agent, reads the protected agent environment, and starts or restarts failed agents without overwriting identity.
a.text: Runs separately from the agent, reads

a.xlink:title: Heartbeat, telemetry, and health publishers. Publish fresh runtime signals used to derive Online, Offline, Stale, Agent stopped, and Remote access not ready states.
a.text: Publish fresh runtime signals used to

a.xlink:title: Reconnect watchdog and supervisor recovery. Separates running-but-disconnected recovery from stopped-agent recovery and exposes truthful guidance when no supervisor is available.
Tailscale remote access. Provides private Tailnet connectivity and HTTPS identity without becoming a browser-held secret or control owner.
a.text: and HTTPS identity without becoming a...

a.xlink:title: PROot Ubuntu application container. Hosts verified applications such as PhotoPrism without making documentation tooling or the browser a runtime dependency.
PhotoPrism. Provides the verified managed photo application under a same-origin Caddy path.
a.text: PROot Ubuntu on server host · PM2 / PROot Ubuntu

a.xlink:title: GitHub repository. Hosts source and release workflow definitions; it is not a Lite runtime apply owner.
a.text: definitions; it is not a Lite runtime...

a.xlink:title: GitHub Release. Publishes the verified Lite release manifest, checksums, and dist.zip assets for the release subprocess.
Date-based Lite tag, dist.zip, checksums, and release manifest. Defines immutable release identity and the exact assets required for a Lite installation.
